text:
alex: Deploybot reports a sustained p95 regression on /embed after the 03:00 deploy. deploybot suggests autorevert.
deploybot: AUTOREVERT_TRIGGER: route=/embed p95>380ms duration=7m error_rate=1.8% -> recommended_action: autorevert to redwood-embed-1.2.4
maria: I can reproduce in staging; looks like new batching logic causing head-of-line blocking on some GPUs. not a total outage but noticeable.
devops: change window open for 12m. I'd prefer manual rollback to coordinate release notes + Dedicated notices.
release_manager: standby for a rollback blurb if you decide to go manual. need impact scope and ETA.
alex: decision in 6m. if p95 stays >380ms we manual rollback. who will execute?
maria: I'll run the rollback, devops handle pins. eng_oncall will watch metrics.
devops: created regional pin: route=apac -> model=redwood-embed-1.2.4 at 5150001120 (log).
eng_oncall: muting noisy alerts, watching p95 and error rate.
maria: running rollback now: `deployctl rollback --route global --to-model redwood-embed-1.2.4`
deploybot: MANUAL_ROLLBACK_STARTED by maria at 5150001126 -> state=initiated
eng_oncall: metrics: p95 dropping, errors stable.
deploybot: MANUAL_ROLLBACK_COMPLETED by maria at 5150001129 -> status=success
release_manager: posted rollback note to #customer-facing and updated support playbook. notifying Dedicated PMs.
alex: follow-ups: add e2e for batching, add deploybot suppress window during noisy metric periods, postmortem ticket PM-789 assigned to maria+devops.
